fullDescription: A maximalist, neo-brutalist agency / design-studio homepage: full-saturation magenta #ff2db7 + cyan #00d4ff + yellow #ffd000 on white/ink #0a0a0a, flat color blocks with thick 3-5px black borders and hard offset pop-shadows (no blur, no gradients), a giant uppercase Archivo Black headline with color-highlighted words, Space Grotesk UI, a sticky nav, oversized bordered project tiles with abstract icon-on-color-grid art, a services card grid, two scrolling marquees, and a bold floating-shape CTA. Loud, playful, conversion-shaped.

structured.summary: A maximalist, neo-brutalist agency / design-studio homepage built from loud color blocks, oversized condensed display type, and hard 3-5px black borders with offset 'pop' shadows. A sticky white nav (a 3-bar magenta/cyan/yellow logo glyph + a black pill 'Start a project' CTA) sits above a grain-textured hero: a tiny uppercase eyebrow row, a giant Archivo Black headline ('WEBSITES THAT REFUSE TO BE IGNORED') where words are accented in magenta and inside a tilted cyan highlight box, a lead paragraph + two bordered pill CTAs, and a 3-up bordered stat block, capped by a full-bleed 4-cell color strip (magenta/cyan/yellow/black). Below: a black scrolling marquee of slogans, a 'Selected Work' section of oversized bordered project tiles (each a color panel + an abstract icon-on-color-grid 'image' half, with index/category, big title, blurb, and pill tags), a magenta 'What we do' services grid of white bordered cards with color icon chips, a yellow client-name marquee, a white 'studio' about split (clipped-highlight statement + 4 bordered stat tiles), a cyan closing CTA with floating geometric shapes and an email pill, and a black 4-column footer with newsletter input. The signature is the brutalist kit: thick black edges, 8-12px hard offset shadows, full-saturation magenta+cyan+yellow on white/black, dot-grain texture, and two infinite marquees.

style.description: Loud, playful neo-brutalist maximalism. Everything is built from a tight high-saturation palette on stark white and near-black: magenta #ff2db7, cyan #00d4ff, yellow #ffd000, ink #0a0a0a, and white #ffffff, used as flat full-bleed color blocks (no gradients, no soft shadows). Structure comes from hard black borders: 3px (edge), 5px (edge-thick), plus 4px section borders (border-y-4 border-ink), and depth comes exclusively from hard OFFSET shadows (8px 8px 0 ink, and 12px 12px 0 ink on big tiles) rather than blur. Type is the loudest element: a heavy Archivo Black 'display' face with negative tracking (-0.03em) and crushed line-height (0.86), set HUGE via clamp() and almost always UPPERCASE, with single words accented by color or wrapped in a slightly rotated (-1deg) solid color highlight box that itself carries a pop-shadow. Supporting copy + UI is Space Grotesk (medium/bold, often uppercase micro-labels with wide 0.18-0.2em tracking); body is Archivo. Texture is a faint dot 'grain' (radial-gradient dots at 4px). Motion is two CSS marquees (one forward, one reverse) with a soft edge mask, plus tiny hover transforms (translate, scale, rotate) on tiles/cards. Icons are Iconify Lucide line glyphs (lucide:*), often oversized with a hard drop-shadow.
style.prompt: Maximalist neo-brutalist agency website. Load Tailwind via CDN and register a tailwind.config with EXACT custom colors: magenta #ff2db7, cyan #00d4ff, yellow #ffd000, ink #0a0a0a; fonts grotesk=['Space Grotesk'], archivo=['Archivo'], black=['"Archivo Black"']. Body: bg #ffffff, font-archivo, text-ink, antialiased. Define helper classes: .display { font-family:'"Archivo Black"','Archivo',sans-serif; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:-0.03em; line-height:0.86 } (the giant headline face); .edge { border:3px solid #0a0a0a }; .edge-thick { border:5px solid #0a0a0a }; .shadow-pop { box-shadow:8px 8px 0 #0a0a0a }; .shadow-pop-lg { box-shadow:12px 12px 0 #0a0a0a }; .grain { background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size:4px 4px }; two marquees .marquee { animation:marquee 22s linear infinite } / .marquee-rev { animation:marquee-rev 28s linear infinite } with @keyframes translating translateX(0) <-> translateX(-50%) (duplicate the strip and mark the copy aria-hidden); .marquee-mask applies a -webkit-mask-image / mask-image linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 7%, #000 93%, transparent) for soft edges. html { scroll-behavior:smooth }. Use full-saturation flat color blocks, thick black borders, and HARD offset shadows only (never soft/blur shadows, never gradients). Highlighted words sit in a solid color box with a slight -rotate-1 and a .shadow-pop. Icons = Iconify Lucide (load https://code.iconify.design/3/3.1.1/iconify.min.js, use <iconify-icon icon="lucide:...">), often oversized with drop-shadow-[6px_6px_0_#0a0a0a].
style.prompt_typography: Three Google fonts: 'Archivo Black' (display), 'Archivo' 400-900 (body), 'Space Grotesk' 400-700 (UI/labels). Giant display headings use .display (Archivo Black, weight 900, tracking -0.03em, line-height 0.86), UPPERCASE, sized fluidly: hero H1 text-[clamp(54px,12vw,170px)]; section H2 text-[clamp(40px,7vw,88px)]; the closing-CTA H2 text-[clamp(46px,10vw,140px)]; about statement text-[clamp(28px,4.5vw,56px)]; project titles text-[clamp(30px,4vw,56px)] (smaller tiles clamp(26px,3.5vw,44px)). Stat numbers use .display at fixed 34-40px. Eyebrows / micro-labels = Space Grotesk (font-grotesk) font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em]-[0.2em] at 11-13px. Nav + buttons = font-grotesk font-bold ~14-18px. Lead/body paragraphs = font-grotesk text-[15px]-[21px] leading-snug, often at reduced opacity (text-ink/70, text-ink/80). Service card titles use font-black (Archivo 900) text-2xl uppercase. Client marquee names = font-black text-[40px] uppercase.

layout_and_structure.description: A single-column, vertically stacked, fully responsive marketing page. Every section centers its content in mx-auto max-w-[1400px] with px-5 -> sm:px-8 padding; most sections are separated by full-bleed 4px black borders (border-y-4 border-ink). Order top to bottom: (1) a sticky white nav with a 4px bottom border; (2) a grain hero (eyebrow row, giant headline, lead + 2 CTAs + 3-up stat blocks) ending in a full-bleed 4-cell color strip; (3) a black scrolling slogan marquee; (4) a white 'Selected Work' section of oversized bordered project tiles (two full-width alternating tiles + a 2-up row of smaller tiles); (5) a magenta 'What we do' services section (3-col bordered card grid); (6) a yellow reverse-direction client-name marquee; (7) a white 'studio' about split (statement + 2x2 stat tiles); (8) a cyan closing CTA with floating absolute shapes; (9) a black 4-column footer with newsletter signup and a bottom legal row. Reflow: nav links hide below lg (compact logo + CTA remain); hero stat blocks stay 3-up but the headline scales via clamp; the hero color strip is grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-4; work tiles are grid lg:grid-cols-2 that stack on mobile (with order swaps so the color/icon 'image' half leads), and the 2-up small-tile row collapses to 1; services grid sm:grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-3 -> 1; about split is lg:grid-cols-12 (7/5) that stacks, its stat tiles grid-cols-2; the closing-CTA decorative shapes are hidden below sm/lg; footer is md:grid-cols-12 (5/2/2/3) that stacks. Both marquees animate horizontally with an edge mask.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white header with border-b-4 border-ink. Inside mx-auto max-w-[1400px] px-5 -> sm:px-8, h-[68px], flex items-center justify-between. Left brand: a logo glyph of three stacked vertical bars (each w-3 h-7) in magenta / cyan / yellow side by side, next to the .display wordmark 'HYPERBLOK' text-[22px]. Center (hidden lg:flex, font-grotesk font-medium text-[15px], gap-1): Work / Services / Clients / Studio / Contact, each px-3 py-2 hover:text-magenta. Right: a hidden-sm 'EN' language label with a cyan lucide:globe icon, plus a black pill CTA 'Start a project' (bg-ink text-white font-grotesk font-bold text-sm px-5 py-2.5 rounded-full hover:bg-magenta).

A relative .grain bg-white overflow-hidden section. Inside mx-auto max-w-[1400px] px-5 -> sm:px-8, pt-12 -> sm:pt-16, pb-0. Top eyebrow row (flex flex-wrap justify-between, font-grotesk text-[13px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em]): left = a pulsing magenta dot (w-2 h-2 rounded-full animate-pulse) + 'Booking Q3 2026'; right = 'Independent design studio - est. 2019' (text-ink/70). Then the hero H1 in .display text-[clamp(54px,12vw,170px)] uppercase, three lines: 'Websites' / 'that refuse' / 'to be ignored'. Below (mt-9, grid lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-end): left col-span-7 = a font-grotesk text-[18px]-[21px] leading-snug text-ink/80 max-w-xl lead paragraph, then mt-7 two pill CTAs: a primary 'See the work' (bg-magenta text-ink font-grotesk font-bold px-7 py-4 rounded-full .edge .shadow-pop, hover nudges up-left) and a secondary 'Get a quote' (bg-white .edge rounded-full hover:bg-yellow). Right col-span-5 = a grid-cols-3 gap-3 of three .edge stat blocks p-4 text-center: yellow '120+ Sites shipped', cyan '4.9 Avg rating', magenta '11 Awards' (numbers in .display text-[34px], labels font-grotesk text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase).

A full-bleed mt-12 grid grid-cols-2 -> sm:grid-cols-4 with border-y-4 border-ink. Four cells each h-[120px] -> sm:h-[150px], flex items-end p-4, with a border-r-4 border-ink between them: bg-magenta 'Brand', bg-cyan 'Web', bg-yellow 'Motion' (labels font-grotesk font-bold text-ink text-sm uppercase tracking-wide), and bg-ink 'Build' (white text).

A bg-ink text-white py-4 overflow-hidden section with border-b-4 border-ink and .marquee-mask. A flex whitespace-nowrap .marquee track duplicated twice (second copy aria-hidden). Each copy = .display text-[30px] uppercase slogans separated by oversized magenta/cyan/yellow lucide:asterisk icons: 'Design that converts' / 'No templates' (cyan) / 'Built to ship' / 'Loud by default' (yellow).

Section id=work, bg-white, mx-auto max-w-[1400px] px-5 -> sm:px-8, py-16 -> sm:py-24. Header row (flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between): an H2 .display text-[clamp(40px,7vw,88px)] uppercase 'Selected
Work' + a font-grotesk text-ink/60 max-w-xs blurb. Then space-y-8: TWO full-width tiles, each an with a grid lg:grid-cols-2 .edge-thick .shadow-pop-lg overflow-hidden. One half is a COPY panel (a solid color bg, p-8 -> sm:p-12, flex-col justify-between min-h-[300px]): an uppercase index/category eyebrow ('01 / E-commerce'), an .display project title (clamp(30px,4vw,56px)), a blurb, then a row of black pill tags (bg-ink text-white text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full) + a 'View ->' link with lucide:arrow-right that widens its gap on group-hover. The OTHER half is the ABSTRACT IMAGE panel (bg-ink, min-h-[280px]): an absolute inset grid of color cells (e.g. grid-cols-3 grid-rows-3 or grid-cols-4 grid-rows-2 filled with magenta/cyan/yellow/ink) with a centered oversized white/ink lucide icon (lucide:zap, lucide:orbit) at text-[120px] drop-shadow-[6px_6px_0_...] that scales/rotates on hover. Alternate which half leads (use order classes; on tile 2 the image leads on lg). Then a 2-up row: grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8 of two SMALLER tiles (.edge-thick .shadow-pop, min-h-[260px]): a yellow tile '03 / Editorial - Ember Mag' and a black tile '04 / Studio - Nuro Lab', each with a small abstract icon-on-color-grid band (h-[110px], lucide:flame / lucide:shapes at text-[64px] with hard drop-shadow) above the index/title/blurb.

Section id=services, bg-magenta with border-y-4 border-ink, relative overflow-hidden, mx-auto max-w-[1400px] px-5 -> sm:px-8, py-16 -> sm:py-24. Header row: an H2 .display text-white text-[clamp(40px,7vw,88px)] uppercase 'What we
do' + a font-grotesk text-ink font-medium blurb. Then grid sm:grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-3 gap-5 of service cards: five bg-white .edge p-7 cards (hover:-translate-y-1), each with a w-14 h-14 color icon chip (.edge, bg cyan/yellow/magenta) holding a lucide icon (pen-tool, layout-dashboard, code-2, sparkles, target), an uppercase font-black text-2xl title (Brand Identity / Web Design / Development / Motion / Conversion), and a font-grotesk text-ink/70 text-[15px] description; plus a sixth bg-ink text-white .edge card 'Need it all?' (yellow icon chip with lucide:arrow-up-right) with a yellow 'Let's talk ->' link at the bottom.

Section id=clients, bg-yellow with border-b-4 border-ink, py-5 overflow-hidden, .marquee-mask. A flex whitespace-nowrap .marquee-rev (REVERSE direction) track duplicated (second aria-hidden): font-black text-[40px] uppercase client names separated by small magenta/cyan bullet dots (text-magenta / text-cyan): Voltaic - Orbita - Ember - Nuro Lab - Drift - Pulse.

Section id=about, bg-white, mx-auto max-w-[1400px] px-5 -> sm:px-8, py-16 -> sm:py-24. A grid lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 items-center. Left col-span-7: an uppercase eyebrow with a small magenta square ('The studio'), then a big .display text-[clamp(28px,4.5vw,56px)] uppercase statement with a clipped highlight ('We make the internet louder, one brand at a time.'), then a font-grotesk text-ink/70 text-[17px] paragraph. Right col-span-5: a grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 of four .edge stat tiles p-5: cyan '7y Independent', magenta '3 Continents', yellow '98% Repeat clients', ink '<1s Load time' (numbers in .display text-[40px]).

Section id=contact, bg-cyan with border-y-4 border-ink, relative overflow-hidden. Decorative floating shapes (absolute, hidden on small screens): a magenta rounded-full blob top-right (w-52 h-52), a yellow .edge rotate-12 square (w-28 h-28), a small ink rounded-full circle, and a small yellow rotate-45 diamond. Content mx-auto max-w-[1400px] px-5 -> sm:px-8, py-20 -> sm:py-28, relative: an uppercase eyebrow ('Let's build something loud'), a giant H2 .display text-ink text-[clamp(46px,10vw,140px)] uppercase max-w-4xl ('Got a brand that needs to yell?'), then mt-10 a flex flex-wrap gap-5 of two big pills: a black email CTA 'hi@hyperblok.studio' (bg-ink text-white px-9 py-5 rounded-full .shadow-pop + lucide:arrow-up-right, hover:bg-magenta) and a white 'Book a call' (.edge rounded-full hover:bg-yellow).

A bg-ink text-white footer. Inside mx-auto max-w-[1400px] px-5 -> sm:px-8, py-14: a grid md:grid-cols-12 gap-10. Block 1 (col-span-5): the three-bar magenta/cyan/yellow logo glyph + .display 'HYPERBLOK', a font-grotesk text-white/60 max-w-sm blurb, and a row of three social icon buttons (w-11 h-11 rounded-full border-2 border-white/30, lucide:instagram/twitter/dribbble) that each fill with magenta/cyan/yellow on hover. Block 2 (col-span-2) 'Studio' link list, Block 3 (col-span-2) 'Connect' link list (font-grotesk text-[15px], hover:text-cyan / text-magenta). Block 4 (col-span-3) 'Newsletter': a blurb + an inline email input (bg-white/10 border-2 border-white/20 rounded-l-full) joined to a magenta rounded-r-full submit button with lucide:arrow-right. Below: a border-t border-white/10 mt-12 pt-6 flex flex-wrap justify-between row (font-grotesk text-white/40 text-sm): copyright, a 'Remote - Worldwide' label with a cyan lucide:globe, and 'Privacy - Terms'.

special_ui_components.description: The core brutalist primitive used everywhere: a flat color (or white) rectangle with a hard 3-5px solid black border and a HARD offset drop shadow (8px or 12px, zero blur), giving a printed/sticker depth. Used for stat blocks, service cards, work tiles, CTA buttons, and the highlight boxes.
special_ui_components.prompt: Define .edge { border:3px solid #0a0a0a }, .edge-thick { border:5px solid #0a0a0a }, .shadow-pop { box-shadow:8px 8px 0 #0a0a0a }, .shadow-pop-lg { box-shadow:12px 12px 0 #0a0a0a }. Compose them on flat color panels (bg-magenta/cyan/yellow/white/ink). NEVER use blur or soft shadows. Interactive elements add a tiny hover transform (e.g. hover:-translate-x-0.5 hover:-translate-y-0.5 or hover:-translate-y-1) so the block looks like it lifts off its shadow.

special_ui_components.component: Giant Archivo Black headline with color-highlight words
special_ui_components.description: The loudest element on the page: massive uppercase condensed display type with crushed line-height, where a single word is either colored (text-magenta) or wrapped in a solid color highlight box that is slightly rotated and carries its own pop-shadow.
special_ui_components.prompt: Set headings in .display { font-family:'"Archivo Black"'; font-weight:900; letter-spacing:-0.03em; line-height:0.86 } UPPERCASE at clamp() sizes (hero up to 170px). Accent one word per line: either word, or wrap it in word (a solid cyan/magenta box, -1deg rotation, hard offset shadow) so the highlight reads like a stamped sticker.

special_ui_components.description: Project tiles avoid real photos: the image half is a black panel with an absolutely-positioned grid of saturated color cells, overlaid by a single oversized line icon with a hard offset drop-shadow, which scales or rotates on hover.
special_ui_components.prompt: In a work tile's image half (bg-ink overflow-hidden, min-h-[280px]), place an absolute inset-0 grid (grid-cols-3 grid-rows-3 or grid-cols-4 grid-rows-2) of flat color divs (magenta/cyan/yellow/ink in a checker-ish pattern), then an absolute inset-0 flex centering one oversized Iconify Lucide glyph (lucide:zap / lucide:orbit / lucide:flame / lucide:shapes) at text-[120px] (or 64px on small tiles) text-white or text-ink with drop-shadow-[6px_6px_0_#0a0a0a] (or #fff / #ff2db7), with group-hover:scale-110 or group-hover:rotate-12.

special_ui_components.description: Two horizontally scrolling strips: a black slogan marquee under the hero (forward) and a yellow client-name marquee (reverse), each with duplicated content for a seamless loop and a soft gradient edge mask.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build each strip as a flex whitespace-nowrap track with its content duplicated (mark the second copy aria-hidden). Animate with .marquee { animation:marquee 22s linear infinite } / .marquee-rev { animation:marquee-rev 28s linear infinite } and @keyframes marquee { from{translateX(0)} to{translateX(-50%)} } (reverse keyframes swap the two). Wrap in .marquee-mask { -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0, #000 7%, #000 93%, transparent 100%); mask-image:same } so the strip fades at both edges. Slogan marquee = .display 30px uppercase on bg-ink with lucide:asterisk separators; client marquee = font-black 40px uppercase on bg-yellow with colored bullet separators.

structured.special_notes: Frameless, fully responsive neo-brutalist agency / design-studio marketing homepage (no browser chrome / device frame). Built with Tailwind via CDN plus a small tailwind.config registering EXACT custom colors (magenta #ff2db7, cyan #00d4ff, yellow #ffd000, ink #0a0a0a) and font families (grotesk='Space Grotesk', archivo='Archivo', black='"Archivo Black"'); Google Fonts loads Archivo (400-900), Archivo Black, and Space Grotesk (400-700); icons are Iconify Lucide (lucide:*) via the iconify-icon web component. The transferable value is the MAXIMALIST NEO-BRUTALIST KIT, not the specific agency content: a tight full-saturation magenta+cyan+yellow palette on white/black, flat color blocks with hard 3-5px black borders (.edge/.edge-thick) and HARD offset pop-shadows (.shadow-pop 8px / .shadow-pop-lg 12px, zero blur, no gradients), giant uppercase Archivo Black display type (tracking -0.03em, line-height 0.86, clamp() up to 170px) with single words colored or set in slightly-rotated solid highlight boxes, Space Grotesk for UI/eyebrows and Archivo for body, a faint dot 'grain' texture, abstract icon-on-color-grid panels instead of photos, and two edge-masked CSS marquees (one forward, one reverse) with tiny hover transforms throughout. Layout = sticky white nav -> grain hero (eyebrow + giant headline + lead/CTAs + 3-up stats) + full-bleed 4-cell color strip -> black slogan marquee -> Selected Work oversized bordered tiles -> magenta services card grid -> yellow client marquee -> white about split with stat tiles -> cyan CTA with floating shapes -> black 4-column footer. Reflow: nav links hide below lg; the hero color strip is 2-up -> 4-up; work tiles are lg:grid-cols-2 that stack (with order swaps so the abstract 'image' leads on mobile); the small-tile row and services grid collapse to 1; the about split is 12-col (7/5); the CTA decorative shapes hide on small screens; the footer is md:grid-cols-12 (5/2/2/3); everything is centered in mx-auto max-w-[1400px] with px-5 -> sm:px-8. All copy and the 'HYPERBLOK' brand are placeholders meant to be swapped. Keep the palette full-saturation; the whole point is loud.
